name: Cake Canvas
tagline: Design, size and decorate cakes like a pro
about: Cake Canvas turns an occasion into a full cake design brief, sizes tiers for your guest count, mixes exact buttercream colours and critiques your decorating from a photo.
persona: You are a working cake decorator and pastry instructor: precise about grams, tier structure and food-safe practice, generous with beginner-friendly shortcuts.

onboarding.title: Every cake starts with a plan
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your skill level and what you usually bake; we'll tailor designs and quantities.

tools.title: Design my cake
tools.subtitle: Occasion → full concept

inputs.label: Theme / colours / must-haves
inputs.placeholder: sage green and gold, loves roses

tools.prompt: Design a {style} cake for {occasion} with brief: {theme}. Produce 3 concepts as cards (title, one-paragraph look, meta = difficulty · decorating hours), then for the strongest concept a kv (cake flavour, filling, frosting, colour palette as 3 named shades, toppers), a checklist of every decorating item to buy or prep, and a callout on what to simplify if time runs short.

tools.title: Servings & pan math
tools.subtitle: Tiers, batter, dowels
tools.prompt: Size a {shape} cake with {tiers} tiers to serve {guests} party-size portions. Table (Tier | Tin size | Height | Servings | Batter grams | Frosting grams), steps for stacking with dowel count and board sizes per tier, a kv of bake temperature and minutes per tin, and a callout on transport and fridge stability.

tools.title: Mix a colour
tools.subtitle: Gel drops for any shade

inputs.label: Target colour
inputs.placeholder: dusty rose, like the bridesmaid dresses

tools.prompt: Give a colour recipe for {target} in {grams} g of the profile frosting using only these gels: {gels}. Kv (drops or toothpicks per gel, in order), steps to mix and let the colour develop, a table (Shade | Adjustment | For lighter | For darker) covering 3 nearby shades, and a callout on colours that deepen overnight or bleed.

tools.title: Critique my cake
tools.subtitle: Photo → what to fix next time

inputs.label: What you were going for
inputs.placeholder: smooth sharp edges with a drip

tools.prompt: Critique the decorated cake in the attached photo against the goal '{goal}'. Bullets of what is working, a table (Issue | Likely cause | Fix next time) for up to 5 issues you can actually see, steps for the single highest-impact technique to practise, and a quote with one encouraging line to send with a picture of the cake.

tools.title: Bake-day timeline
tools.subtitle: Backwards plan from the deadline

inputs.label: The cake
inputs.placeholder: 2-tier vanilla with Swiss meringue and sugar flowers

tools.prompt: Build a backwards timeline to deliver {cake} by {due}. Steps by day and hour (bake, cool, fill, crumb-coat, chill, final coat, decorate, deliver) with rest and chill times, a checklist of what can be made ahead and frozen, and a callout on fridge and room-temperature limits for the fillings involved.
